name: Hardware, Handheld & Power Optimization Suite
author: WinCare Core Team
description: Hardware telemetry, battery health analyzer, power scheme selector, and display refresh rate diagnostic suite.

tools.title: Battery Health & AC Power State
tools.summary: Probes hardware battery capacity, charge percentage, charging status, and remaining runtime estimates.

tools.title: Windows Power Scheme & Profile Policy
tools.summary: Queries active Windows power scheme (Balanced, High Performance, Power Saver, Ultimate Performance).

tools.title: Display Resolution & Refresh Rate Metrics
tools.summary: Inspects active primary display resolution, refresh rate frequency (Hz), and color bit-depth.
